basic_profile.bio: A passionate anime fan based in Seattle, who has been exploring the world of manga and anime for over a decade. Often found debating plot twists and character development in niche anime subreddits. Works as a graphic designer by day. Enjoys a cup of matcha while delving into the latest episodes of trending series. Currently single and often online late evenings after work, usually between 8 PM and midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a deep understanding of anime series, particularly in the romance and fantasy genres, garnered through years of watching and participating in online discussions. Additional expertise in digital art, gained through formal education and self-taught techniques via online tutorials.
